ayahs.tr: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.ar: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا͏ٓ اَتٰىهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ ۝٣
ayahs.tr: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰي عَلَي الْعَرْشِؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٍؕ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ ۝٤
ayahs.tr: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

ayahs.ar: يُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ اِلَي الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ اِلَيْهِ فِيْ يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗٓ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ ۝٥
ayahs.tr: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۝٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْٓ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَبَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِيْنٍ ۝٧ۚ
ayahs.tr: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّا࢜ءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۝٨ۚ
ayahs.tr: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ سَوّٰىهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِهٖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ ۝٩
ayahs.tr: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوْٓا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْاَرْضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِيْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ࣢ؕ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَا࢜ءِ رَبِّهِمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: And they say, "When we are lost within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: قُلْ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِيْ وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلٰي رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ۝١١ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Say, "The angel of death will take you who has been entrusted with you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ تَرٰٓي اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ نَاكِسُوْا رُءُوْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْؕ رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا اِنَّا مُوْقِنُوْنَ ۝١٢
ayahs.tr: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ شِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا لَاٰتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدٰىهَا وَلٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّيْ لَاَمْلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.

ayahs.ar: فَذُوْقُوْا بِمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَا࢜ءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّا نَسِيْنٰكُمْ وَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهَا خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوْا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ ۝١٥ࣛ
ayahs.tr: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

ayahs.ar: تَتَجَافٰي جُنُوْبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًاؗ وَّمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّا͏ٓ اُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ اَعْيُنٍۚ جَزَا࢜ءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝١٧
ayahs.tr: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًاؕؔ لَا يَسْتَوٗنَ ۝١٨ؔ
ayahs.tr: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ الْمَاْوٰيؗ نُزُلًاۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فَسَقُوْا فَمَاْوٰىهُمُ النَّارُؕ كُلَّمَا͏ٓ اَرَادُوْٓا اَنْ يَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَا͏ٓ اُعِيْدُوْا فِيْهَا وَقِيْلَ لَهُمْ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."

ayahs.ar: وَلَنُذِيْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنٰي دُوْنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: And we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَاؕ اِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ ۝٢٢ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَي الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِيْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَا࢜ىِٕهٖ وَجَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًي لِّبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ ۝٢٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَىِٕمَّةً يَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْاࣞؕ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.tr: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ يَمْشُوْنَ فِيْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍؕ اَفَلَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.tr: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا نَسُوْقُ الْمَا࢜ءَ اِلَي الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا تَاْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَامُهُمْ وَاَنْفُسُهُمْؕ اَفَلَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِيْمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."

ayahs.ar: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّنْتَظِرُوْنَ ۝٣٠ࣖ
ayahs.tr: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
